body: One extra safeguard: huwag hintayin ang January 4 just because iyon ang retroactivity cutoff. Mail delays, incomplete forms, or a document needing clarification can turn a simple claim into a deadline problem. Best practice is submit soon after verifying the green packet, keep a photo/copy of what was sent, and use the official electronic route when appropriate. The downside of acting early is tiny; the downside of procrastination can be several months of support.

claims.text: Submitting well before the cutoff reduces avoidable deadline risk compared with treating January 4 as the target filing date.
claims.basis: Risk-management inference from the article's receipt-based retroactivity deadline
